from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W, H = 800, 240
stripe_h = 40
bg = (15,15,15)
during_img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), color=bg)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(during_img)
stripe_y = H - stripe_h - 20
progress = 0.60
draw.rectangle([0, stripe_y, W, stripe_y+stripe_h], fill=(50,50,50))
draw.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, W, stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(100,100,100), width=2)
draw.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, int(W*progress), stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(180,180,255), width=3)
text = "Target 01:23  Dur 03:45  Progr 60%"
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 14)
except:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
draw.text((W//2 - 140, stripe_y+6), text, fill=(255,255,255), font=font)
during_img_path = "/workspace/during_gesture.png"
during_img.save(during_img_path)
print("saved during_gesture.png at ", during_img_path)

# Post-gesture image (no overlay text)
post_img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), color=bg)
draw2 = ImageDraw.Draw(post_img)
draw2.rectangle([0, stripe_y, W, stripe_y+stripe_h], fill=(50,50,50))
draw2.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, W, stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(100,100,100), width=2)
draw2.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, int(W*progress), stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(180,180,255), width=3)
post_path = "/workspace/post_gesture.png"
post_img.save(post_path)
print("saved post_gesture.png at ", post_path)
